quest.title: Lantern Rite, Big Business?
quest.description: Mr. Zhu seems to want to use the Lantern Rite to pick his business up a little...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Thank you for your service. Here's some Mora, please check the amount.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Sure thing. This Mora will be plenty. Now, will you two travelers be continuing further on your journey, or will you return to the city?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: I've heard that the Mingxiao Lantern will be particularly impressive this year.

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: We...

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: We'll be sure to go see it if we get the chance. Thanks for letting us know, Mr. Zhu.

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Mr. Zhu. Would you be willing to sell us one of your Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: Even if we don't get the opportunity to see the Mingxiao Lantern in the city, it would still be nice to release a Xiao Lantern, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Yes, it is the Lantern Rite after all.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Sure, no problem at all! I just happen to have a few new Xiao Lanterns that were just made today.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Here, you may have this lantern free of charge. It is the Lantern Rite after all, you may keep your Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Thank you, Mr. Zhu. Do you know of a suitable place to release the lantern nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: A place to release a Xiao Lantern, huh? Let me think, it should somewhere higher up... Ah yes, I remember that there should be some suitable places if you follow this road further up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: However, there's been word of monsters appearing on the mountain, so you two should be careful.

talks.objective: Talk to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: There must be a way...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A way to do what?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. You know how it's the time of the Lantern Rite, right? Well, I was trying to think of a way to help give my business a bit of a boost during all the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Good location, nice scenery, and food... we've got plenty of that, too.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: I can see it now...They'll release the Mingxiao Lantern in the city, and here we've got tasty food, plenty to drink, and an incredible view — it's going to be spectacular!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: This'll be my main selling point to attract more customers. What do you think?

choices.text: Will you really be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Uh, of course you can see it from here... The lantern's so big that you'll certainly be able to see part of it, at least.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Anyway, we'll get to that when the time comes. First, I need to get the inn squared away for more guests.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to collect some Xiao Lantern-making materials? I would like to hang some around the inn.

choices.text: I might as well assemble the lanterns while I'm at it...

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: All I need are the materials. Constructing the lanterns can be quite time-consuming.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: So once you've collected the materials, just give them to Dummy and he'll take care of the rest. I'll be attending to other matters in the meantime.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Of course, I won't be letting you leave empty-handed. I'll be sure you're rewarded after some guests come and business picks up.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Uh, well... Even if no guests show up, I'll still have something prepared for you. Don't worry about that.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: I'm sure more guests will start to arrive once the inn is put in good order.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: *cough* Just pass those materials to Dummy. I'll finalize your payment tomorrow based on the situation.

choices.text: There's no way you'll be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Please hurry with the Delicious Jewelry Soup. It's hard enough to get guests as it is, we mustn't disappoint them.

talks.objective: Collect two sets of Xiao Lantern materials

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: We really won't be able to see the Mingxiao Lantern from here?

talks.objective: Collect two sets of Xiao Lantern materials

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: We'll need to make more Xiao Lanterns...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: I need to go attract some guests. I'll give you your rewards a little later.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Hmm... Minghua Bank... Minghua Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Thanks — I was just beginning to worry that we'd run out of materials.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Just give me a moment to make a few more Xiao Lanterns and we can hang them all up together.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: ...And that should just about do it. Here, take these Xiao Lanterns and hang them beside the doors to the inn.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: I still need to make a few more lanterns in case we need them later.

talks.objective: Give Xiao Lantern materials to Dummy

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think I'll still need to make a few more Xiao Lanterns...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About materials for the Xiao Lanterns...

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: Oh right, you can just give the materials to me. I'll take it from here.

talks.objective: Talk to Dummy
Hang the Xiao Lantern on one side of the inn's door

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Very strange indeed... Still no guests.

talks.objective: Hang the Xiao Lantern on the other side of the inn's door

dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: I appreciate your kind offer, but I'm afraid that I cannot abandon my post while I'm on duty.

talks.objective: Meet Mr. Zhu the following afternoon (12:00 – 18:00)

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Right this way, please. Everything's already been prepared, so please have a seat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhu, who are these two...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Ah yes, I was just out attracting guests when I ran into these two.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: That's right, this lady is from Minghua Bank, and I'm one of the bank employees.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: The lady and I were just setting off on a distant journey at the start of the Lantern Rite. I'm afraid she feels a little homesick...

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: So we decided to find a spot to watch the Xiao Lanterns, which is when we happened to meet Mr. Zhu.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Yes, and it just so happens that we've just prepared new Xiao Lanterns for the inn. Hmm... was it Minghua Bank you said? Does that mean—

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Ahem, I shan't pry.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: You two must be exhausted from your journey. Please have a rest while we prepare some food for you.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you lend us a hand again? We'll need to quickly prepare some food for our two guests.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Please prepare a serving of Delicious Jewelry Soup. I'll be sure to compensate you accordingly once things are all settled.

talks.objective: Talk to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Strange, very strange indeed. I wonder what the matter is...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Hardly any guests came at all yesterday... How could that be? There should be loads of travelers for the festival...

choices.text: Maybe it's because hardly anyone ever passes through here...

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: No, that can't be it... There must be something wrong with the way I'm trying to attract guests.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Perhaps it'd be better if I attracted guests more directly...

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: Traveler, could you please go around and attract some guests for me?

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: You can mention that we have good food, nice rooms, and an excellent view for the Lantern Rite festival.

response.speaker: Mr. Zhu
response.text: I'll keep thinking if there are any other ways we can attract some guests...

choices.text: I doubt there'd be many people traveling outside during the Lantern Rite...

talks.objective: Send out invitations to nearby people

dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: Hello. Please wait while we perform a routine inspection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to stay at Mr. Zhu's inn?

dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: Oh? Yes, I have in fact heard about Mr. Zhu's inn.

dialogues.speaker: Zhenxiang
dialogues.text: But I'm on duty now. I appreciate your kind offer, but I'm afraid I cannot just abandon my post.

talks.objective: Send out invitations to the people in the area

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it, youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to stay at Mr. Zhu's inn?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Oh, Mr. Zhu... Yes, I know the place.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: But I'm afraid that his inn is simply too far from here. These old legs couldn't handle such a journey, sorry.

talks.objective: Report back to Mr. Zhu
Cook a Delicious Jewelry Soup

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Good work, Traveler. Please, have a seat and join us.

talks.objective: Give Delicious Jewelry Soup to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: So, is the food ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It certainly is.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Okay, great. These are all the dishes we needed. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, hehe. Here's your food, please enjoy.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Mr. Zhu. Also, this Traveler has gone to great lengths to help with everything. We'd be delighted if {M#he}{F#she} could join us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Hehe, judging from your appearance, you must also be a traveler on some distant journey. The festival makes for a fitting time for people to come together, share a meal, and enjoy a lively time with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: Yes. In fact, would you also care to join us, Mr. Zhu?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Yes, I—I'd be delighted.

talks.objective: Take a seat by the table
Talk to Mr. Zhu
Talk to Jianqiu

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Traveler, I'm sorry to trouble you, but... Would you be willing to escort us up the mountain to release the Xiao Lantern?

response.speaker: Jianqiu
response.text: My apologies. I'm afraid we cannot return to the city at this time because of... certain matters.

response.speaker: Jianqiu
response.text: As such, we'll require your protection on the mountain. We can leave whenever you're ready.

response.speaker: Jianqiu
response.text: After we release the Xiao Lantern, we'll continue on our way.

choices.text: Why don't you return to the city?

talks.objective: Escort the two to a high point to release the Xiao Lantern

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, it's just that I...

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Don't say that. Let's just enjoy watching the Xiao Lanterns while we still may...

talks.objective: Escort the two to a high point to release the Xiao Lantern

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: This would actually be a very suitable place to release the Xiao Lantern. Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: I just hope... that her wish will come true.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler. We should be on our way now.

talks.objective: Talk to Mr. Zhu

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Ah, you're back. *sigh* It's been difficult to attract guests during the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Huh, what about the two guests that were here earlier? Have they left already?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, they've continued on their journey.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... Leaving on a journey during the Lantern Rite mustn't be easy for them.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Huh, now that you mention it... Regardless of whether they were heading towards or away from Liyue, don't you find it a little strange that they continued their journey without stopping for the night?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: When I met them earlier, it was clear from their expressions that they didn't know which way to go.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: They even jumped when I called after them, and there was something a bit off about their attire as well...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Oh, forget about it... Here's the compensation I'd promised you earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Zhu
dialogues.text: Thanks for all your help. I'll get back to matters at the inn now.

dialogues.speaker: Dummy
dialogues.text: We still need to make a few Xiao Lanterns, but we're missing <color=#00E1FFFF>two Lantern Fibers</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>two Wick Materials</color>. The boss says that he'll think of something, though...

talks.objective: Additional
Additional

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Sorry, the inn is simply too far from here. These old legs couldn't handle such a journey.
